stages.label: History
stages.text: 82-year-old who fell at home and cannot bear weight on the left leg. Lives independently. Takes apixaban for atrial fibrillation, last dose this morning.

stages.label: Medical review
stages.text: Alert, oriented. Hemodynamically stable. Renal function normal for age.

guideline.note: Surgical treatment, expedited, with anticoagulation managed.

attending.note: Arthroplasty once the anticoagulant timing is managed.
